reexplore.translation: v. 再探索,再勘探,重新勘查,重新探测

reexport.definition:
v. t. To export again, as what has been imported.
n. Any commodity reexported; -- chiefly in the plural.
reexport.translation:
vt. 再输出, 再出口
n. 再输出

reexportation.definition: n. The act of reexporting, or of exporting an import.
reexportation.translation: n. 再输出, 再出口
